Title: Network Operations Senior Advisor (Network Operations)
Description:

**Position Objective:**

The Senior Advisor serves as the principal strategic and technical sounding board to the VP of Network Operations. Orchestrating operational excellence across all network domains and drive the transition from a complex legacy infrastructure to a future-state, zero-touch architecture – targeting TM Forum Autonomous Network Level 4 (ANL 4) maturity and a modernized, unified NOC.

**Job Description & Responsibilities:**

* Act as the primary trusted advisor to the VP of Network Operations on long-term strategy, operational risk management, and technology lifecycle investments.
* Evaluate and translate emerging technological trends (e.g., 6G readiness, advanced edge computing, network slicing) into actionable, high-yield operational roadmaps.
* Advise on the governance of operational frameworks across the entirety of the operator’s footprint to ensure alignment with global standards and corporate KPIs.
* Provide strategic direction and operational efficiency oversight across eight core domains:
* Mobile Network: Next-gen RAN, vRAN, OpenRAN, and multi-generation (4G/5G/5G-Advanced) core alignment.
* Fixed Network: FTTx, GPON, and next-generation fixed access operations.
* Transport Network: IP/MPLS, Optical (DWDM), Segment Routing, and microwave backhaul optimization.
* Core & Cloud Network: Cloud-native network functions (CNFs/VNFs), telco cloud infrastructure (OpenStack, Kubernetes), and hybrid-cloud operational paradigms.
* IT Operations: Alignment of corporate IT infrastructure, workplace tech, and data center operations with network functions.
* Cybersecurity: Embedding DevSecOps into network operations, ensuring infrastructure resilience, threat mitigation, and strict regulatory compliance.
* OSS/BSS: Transforming legacy Operations and Business Support Systems into agile, microservices-driven architectures.
* AIOps Strategy Formulation: Define the overarching AI/ML roadmap for Network Operations to move toward predictive, generative, and closed-loop autonomous operations.
* AIOps Implementation: Drive the deployment of Artificial Intelligence for AI Operations (AIOps) platforms to ingest vast streams of telemetry data across Fixed, Mobile, and Cloud networks for real-time anomaly detection and predictive scaling.
* Generative AI & LLMs in Ops: Evaluate and pilot Generative AI applications (such as LLM-powered network assistants) to accelerate Tier-1/Tier-2 engineering troubleshooting, synthesize complex RCA (Root Cause Analysis) logs, and automate routine configuration scripts safely.
* Data Governance for Networks: Collaborate with Chief Data Officers/IT to establish robust data pipelines, ensuring clean, structured, and real-time network telemetry data is available to train and mature AI models.
* AI Governance & Explainability: Ensure AI/ML and closed-loop automation decisions remain auditable and explainable (XAI), preserving engineer trust and regulatory compliance as autonomy increases.
* AI Capability Upskilling: Act as a change agent to foster an AI-first mindset across the engineering workforce, advising the VP on the talent and skills gap required to operate a cognitive network.
* Lead the transformation of the NOC from siloed, domain-specific monitoring into a unified command center, consolidating EMS/NMS, service assurance, and orchestration tooling across Fixed, Mobile, Transport, Core, Cloud, and IT domains.
* Define and continuously optimize the NOC’s tiered support structure (Tier 0 automated remediation through Tier 3 specialist escalation), shifting resolution through automation, runbooks, and AI-assisted diagnostics.
* Drive AI/ML-based event correlation, event de-duplication, and noise reduction, ensuring NOC engineers focus exclusively on actionable, service-impacting events.
* Own the end-to-end Major Incident Management process, including rapid triage, cross-domain war-room coordination, executive communication, and post-incident root-cause and problem management.
* Ensure 24/7 operational resilience through effective staffing model, shift patterns, and escalation matrices that sustain continuous, around-the-clock network assurance aligned with contractual SLA commitments.
* NOC-SOC Integration: Partner with the Cybersecurity function to align NOC monitoring and incident-response workflows with Security Operations Center (SOC) processes, ensuring unified visibility into service-impacting and security-impacting events.
* Progress the NOC toward TM Forum Autonomous Network Level 4 (ANL 4) — highly autonomous, closed-loop operations — with measurable maturity targets across priority domains.
* ANL Level 4 Transition: Architect and drive the migration from manual/reactive troubleshooting to Autonomous Advanced Operations Model Level 4 (Intent-driven, highly autonomous closed-loop operations).
* Zero-Touch Self-Healing: Recommend, design, and champion AI/ML-driven initiatives to achieve predictive maintenance, automated anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis (RCA) to enable a self-healing infrastructure.
* OPEX Optimization: Identify structural inefficiencies across domains and execute modernization programs that significantly reduce operational costs while boosting Network Quality of Experience (QoE).
* Energy & Sustainability Optimization: Drive AI-based optimization of RAN and site power usage to cut energy cost, reduce emissions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Align all operational transformation workflows, information models, and open APIs with TM Forum Open Digital Architecture (ODA) - including eTOM, SID, and the Functional Framework to enable vendor-agnostic interoperability and support zero-touch, AI-ready operations.
* Enforce and mature the FCAPS (Fault, Configuration, Accounting, Performance, Security) model through modern, automated tooling.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or a strictly related technical field is required.
* A Master’s Degree (M.Sc. or MBA) is highly preferred
* Minimum of 20 years of progressive experience within the Telecommunications or closely related ICT sector.
* At least 5 years in a similar executive advisory capacity, or a senior management role within a Tier-1 telecom operator.
* Documented history of leading large-scale network transformation, automation, or modernization initiatives that yielded measurable OPEX savings or reliability gains.
* Deep understanding of complex network ecosystems (Fixed, Mobile, Transport, Core, IT, Cyber).
* Demonstrated experience leading or transforming a large-scale, 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC), including tiered escalation models, major incident management, and modern NOC tooling (EMS/NMS, ITSM/ticketing, alarm correlation, AIOps platforms).
* Comprehensive knowledge of TM Forum Open Digital Architecture (ODA) — including eTOM, SID, and the Functional Frameworkand traditional FCAPS infrastructure management.
* Comprehensive knowledge of AI/ML applications in telecom operations (AIOps), network virtualization (NFV/SDN), and orchestration engines.
* Industry certifications and memberships (e.g., PMP, ITIL, TOGAF, CCIE, or equivalent) are considered a plus
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to distill highly technical, fragmented architectural issues into clear, risk-managed business cases for C-suite executives and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to balance immediate operational fire-fighting with the long-term vision of proactive and zero-touch autonomy.
* Strong adaptability and a drive for continual improvement.
* Experience in time management and task prioritization.
* Excellent verbal and written English; Arabic is an advantage.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to perform under pressure without compromising quality.

Title: Head of Infrastructure and Cybersecurity

DT One operates a leading global network for mobile top-up, digital value products and rewards. Through a single API connection, we link more than 2,800 partners, including mobile operators, money transfer operators, e-wallets, super apps and retail networks, across 190 countries. Our partners can offer over 23,000 products, from airtime and data top-ups to gift cards and bill payments. We have processed more than 1.2 billion transactions and reach a potential audience of over five billion people, helping to ensure that no one is left unconnected.
  
  
Founded in 2005 and part of the Thunes group, DT One is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in Dubai, Miami, Nairobi, London and Barcelona.
  
  
For more information visit www.dtone.com
  
  
**Context of the role**
We're looking for a Head of Infrastructure and Cybersecurity who is passionate about protecting platforms that move money and value in real time, and who wants to shape how security and infrastructure are run across a fast-growing, global business. As part of the Technology leadership team, you will own the security strategy, reference architecture and roadmap for DT One, and lead the team that builds and runs our infrastructure and security controls day to day.
  
  
You will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Our platform processes millions of transactions every month, connects thousands of partners across 190 countries and runs 24/7 on AWS. That means our infrastructure must be resilient, our identities and privileged access tightly governed, our edge protected, and our security operations able to detect and respond quickly, while meeting the expectations of payment schemes, regulators, auditors and investors in every market we operate in.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction with the senior leadership team and act as design authority for new platforms, while staying close enough to the engineering to lead major programmes yourself, such as zero-trust access, SIEM modernisation and security as code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a highly driven, technically excellent security and infrastructure leader who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company. In this role, you will own how DT One's infrastructure is designed, secured and operated, from the network edge and cloud landing zone through to identity, endpoints and the security operations centre.
  
  

* Define and own the security strategy, reference architectures and multi-year roadmap, working with senior leadership; run security assessments and gap analyses across the business to prioritise the controls that matter most
* Act as security design authority, reviewing and approving the architecture of new products, platforms and partner integrations so that security is designed in from the start
* Own the cloud and infrastructure security posture on AWS (and any multi-cloud footprint), including landing zone design, guardrails, CSPM, CIS hardening and security Infrastructure as Code in Terraform
* Lead network and edge security, including WAF, DDoS protection, DNS, next-generation firewalls, micro-segmentation and network access control, and drive the move to zero-trust network access in place of legacy VPN
* Own identity and access management: identity architecture, SSO (SAML, OIDC), MFA and passwordless, Conditional Access, privileged access management, identity governance and automated joiner-mover-leaver processes
* Lead security operations and the SOC, including SIEM strategy and migration, log source onboarding, detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, ingestion cost optimisation, audit logging and incident response
* Run endpoint and vulnerability management across the estate, including EDR, MDM/MAM, patching, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing and remediation with engineering teams
* Lead PCI-DSS compliance and recertification, and align our controls to ISO 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls
* Lead the security workstream for audits, partner assessments, M&A and investor due diligence, and maintain clear security architecture documentation for executives, auditors and the Board
* Set governance for the safe use of AI and generative-AI services across the business, including technical controls on unapproved tools
* Own the infrastructure and security budget: build business cases for new controls and technologies, lead vendor selection and proofs of concept, and manage a multi-vendor environment
* Build, lead and develop a team across infrastructure security, IAM, security operations and SOC, including hiring, performance management and career development

**What we are looking for**

* 15+ years' experience across infrastructure, networking and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years leading security architecture, engineering or operations teams
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Experience in payments or fintech
* Proven track record of setting security strategy and reference architectures with a CISO or CTO, and acting as design authority for new platforms

Title: Manager Data Center Operations
Description:
**Manager Data Center Operations**

**Your role**

The Manager Data Center Operationsis responsible for overseeing the execution of local data center operations at one or more data center properties. Data center operations include, but are not limited to:

* Engineering operations and core infrastructure maintenance
* Data center construction management, commissioning and start-up
* Delivery of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services and deployment
* Installation and management of all cable and network infrastructure supporting facility and customer connectivity
* Technical event management including post-event root cause analysis and infrastructure repair

**What you’ll do**

* Execute all aspects of data center operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data center operation to achieve 100% uptime and 100% compliance with all customer SLAs.
* Supervises all construction activity and installations, in coordination with internal and external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards.
* Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.
* Manages provisioning of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to data center customers.
* Manages all local customer installations, in coordination with Sales Engineering, Design & Construction and Colocation Operations to coordinate customer move-ins and turn-ups, including deployments, power circuit installations and connectivity requirements.
* Oversees local installation, maintenance and repair of all network infrastructure supporting all Digital Realty and customer connectivity in coordination with internal IT and network personnel.
* Supervise local engineering team to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to guarantee execution of Digital Realty’s periodic maintenance program and maintenance calendar.
* Develop, implement and audit local standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to be in compliance with Digital Realty’s standards and industry best practices.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors and customers.
* Manage all maintenance and repair contracts to ensure compliance with maintenance standards and operational requirements. Confirm all vendors are qualified and adhere to Digital Realty’s performance standards and scopes of work.
* Responsible for timely execution of data center services such as remote hands, customer installations and service requests.
* Supervise security personnel and manage security systems including the adherence to security policies and compliance programs (as required by the Property Manager)
* Act as primary technical and operational contact for data center customers – both as the technical lead and local point of escalation during emergency events and day to day operations. Develop knowledge of customer’s core business and the business function of the customer’s local datacenter operation.

Title: Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
Description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director, Information Technology Infrastructure & Services Delivery
  
  
**Business Unit / Function:**
Pr ocurement & Business Support
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Lead infrastructure technical excellence through standards, solution design, and engineering across Maaden sites. Translate approved IT direction into reliable, scalable infrastructure and reusable capabilities. Enable IT Services Delivery to operate and support services effectively, while keeping day-to-day operations and enterprise strategy ownership with the accountable teams.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Manage the infrastructure Center of Excellence for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Provide technical requirements, design assurance, engineering guidance and knowledge transfer, aligned with enterprise architecture and the Director’s approved priorities.
  
  
**Contract Strategy and Governance**
Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps within enterprise architecture principles. Define technical specifications and acceptance criteria for infrastructure solutions and sourcing. Govern technology selection, standard configurations, and lifecycle plans, including upgrades, refresh, and retirement. Assess emerging technologies for business fit, interoperability, capacity, and supportability. Recommend designs and exceptions through established architecture authorities; enterprise policy and strategy remain with the accountable leaders .
  
  
**Contract Administration and Compliance**
Maintain design documentation, configuration baselines, and engineering procedures. Govern and oversee infrastructure projects within delegated authority, coordinating with PMO and IT Services Delivery on scope, delivery plans, milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, architecture and standards compliance, acceptance, and transition to operations. Review supplier deliverables against agreed specifications and standards. Coordinate design assurance, testing, and operational handover with IT Services Delivery, including support documentation and knowledge transfer. Verify that designs address integration, availability, capacity, recovery, and maintainability before transition. Document technical deviations and corrective actions and escalate non-compliance through the responsible governance and contract owners.
  
  
**Contractor Performance Management**
Assess suppliers’ technical deliverables and engineering quality against agreed requirements. Define and monitor infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) in coordination with IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders; review performance against agreed targets, report deviations and drive corrective actions and continual design improvement. Use recurring-problem evidence from IT Services Delivery to inform engineering improvements. Develop infrastructure automation and DevOps engineering practices with delivery teams to improve repeatability and reduce manual work. Coach technical staff, share reusable designs and strengthen internal engineering capability. Daily operations, service support, and operational supplier SLA management remain with IT Services Delivery
  
  
**Commercial and Cost Management**
Develop capacity and lifecycle recommendations using utilization, availability, and technology requirements. Evaluate infrastructure options for standardization, reuse, and cost efficiency. Provide technical input to procurement, project estimates, and purchase requisitions within assigned responsibility; escalate funding and commercial decisions to the authorized owners. Manage and oversee infrastructure contracts, particularly the Infrastructure & Service Delivery managed service provider contract, within delegated authority and in coordination with Procurement, Legal, IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders. Validate technical scope, deliverables and SLAs/KPIs; oversee contractual compliance, performance reviews, escalations, corrective actions, changes, renewals, and exit/transition planning. Contract approvals remain with authorized signatories, and day-to-day operational ownership remains with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**Risk, HSE and Business Continuity**
Define infrastructure resilience, backup and recovery design requirements with business continuity, security, and delivery teams. Support disaster recovery planning and testing; review technical findings and track engineering improvements. Apply relevant site HSE requirements during infrastructure work and escalate risks. Backup operations, incident response, and service restoration remain with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Infrastructure designs meet agreed standards and business requirements; documented handovers enable effective support. Roadmaps address capacity, lifecycle, and resilience needs. Technical assurance findings are resolved, or formally escalated, recurring issues inform engineering improvements, and delivery teams can reuse documented designs and procedures. Performance targets are agreed through the established management process.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering. ITIL Foundation and ISO 20000-1 service management certification (preferred)
  
  
**Experience**
8–10 years of experience in IT service management, infrastructure, and end-user services, with practical technical requirements, infrastructure project, and standards experience. Good understanding of ITIL and ISO 20000 service management frameworks.
  
  
**Skills That Matter**
Infrastructure planning and technical documentation; analytical diagnosis and problem solving; emerging technology assessment; continuous improvement; stakeholder collaboration and communication; planning and prioritization; people leadership and capability development. Translate operational needs into clear technical specifications and explain design recommendations to technical and management audiences

Title: Technical Program Manager, Network
Description:
**About Cape**
Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.
  
  
Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected
*and*
have privacy.
  
  
We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.
  
  
Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.
  
  
**The Team**
At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.
  
  
**The Role:**
Cape's network team designs how traffic actually moves through our infrastructure: routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and the vendor-implemented changes that make it all work. Right now, that work is coordinated ad hoc, and the team needs someone to take real ownership of task tracking, timeline accountability, and communication across engineering, business development, and vendors. This role is the first of its kind in the network team. We're looking for a Program Manager who is technical enough to challenge engineering estimates, sanity-check what BD is promising customers, and set delivery timelines the team can actually hit.
  
  
You'll work in close partnership with the network operations lead to roadmap upcoming work, surface dependencies and conflicts before they become fire drills, and keep vendors accountable to what they've committed to. Telco or network experience is a plus, but we care more about startup instincts and a bias toward realistic, forward-moving plans than about a background in telecom specifically.
  
  
**What You'll Work On:**

* Own Jira hygiene and task tracking for the network team, bringing structure to work that is currently coordinated informally
* Build a reliable system for tracking work, exposing dependencies, and catching timeline slips early, across network engineering, BD, and vendors
* Partner closely with the network team's technical lead to roadmap infrastructure work like routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and cloud/vendor integrations
* Pressure-test proposed timelines and BD requests for technical feasibility before commitments are made externally
* Host vendor meetings and hold vendors accountable to their delivery commitments
* Deconflict priorities and dependencies across the network team and adjacent teams, including consumer-facing projects
* Translate technical network work for non-technical stakeholders, and translate business requests back into realistic technical asks for engineering
* Help define the org model for how program management, technical ownership, and execution responsibilities fit together on the network team as it scales

**Experience:**

* Technical program management experience in a fast-moving engineering environment, ideally at a startup
* A track record of bringing structure to ambiguous, cross-team work without slowing it down
* Comfort learning a new technical domain quickly and deeply enough to challenge engineering judgment and assess feasibility, not just track progress
* Experience building systems for tracking work, surfacing dependencies, and holding owners accountable to deadlines
* Strong communication skills; able to translate between technical teams and business/vendor stakeholders
* Comfort engaging directly with external vendors and holding them to their commitments
* (Bonus) Experience with network or telco infrastructure: traffic routing, cloud connectivity, configuration, or subscriber provisioning
* (Bonus) Experience at a company building or operating physical/network infrastructure rather than pure software
* (Bonus) Prior experience supporting consumer products alongside more technical/infrastructure work

**Compensation:**
We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted based on your location, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role based in New York, NY is $190,00 - $210,000 depending on level, experience, and interview performance.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* 401(k) match
* 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents
* 12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)
* Stipends for
* Family-forming needs
* Gender-affirming care
* Unlimited PTO

**Our Culture & Values**

* We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning.
* We believe that personal privacy and national security are not at odds, and that they can be reconciled through strong technology.
* We believe companies exist to build awesome things and take care of the people who build them, so we offer top-tier healthcare, 401(k) matching, and a generous vacation policy that our team actually uses to recharge.
* We believe that a stronger company and a better product are built by people from all walks of life. **Our Commitment to You**  
  
At Consumer Cellular, recruiting is human. Every application is reviewed by a real member of our Talent Acquisition team because we believe the people behind the résumé matter just as much as what's on it.

**Job Information**

We are modernizing the systems at the heart of our business. Consumer Cellular is partnering with a world-class technology vendor to implement a cloud-native telco platform, starting with a new product catalog and continuing to a modern billing platform. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead this multi-year transformation end to end: planning, governing, and delivering a program that will change how we launch products, bill our members, and serve them.

You will be the connective tissue across Product, Engineering, Architecture, IT Operations, Finance, Care, and our vendor partners. You will own the integrated plan, drive decisions, manage risk, and make sure what we deliver works for our members on day one.

**Why This Role**

* Build the foundation, not maintain a legacy: replace core telco systems and shape how fast we launch products for years to come.

* Own the full quote-to-cash journey, from product catalog through billing.

* Work with a cloud-native, AI-ready SaaS platform and help shape how we adopt its capabilities.

* High visibility, with direct partnership with executive leadership.

  **What You Will Do**

* Lead the end-to-end program for the new platform implementation, beginning with the product catalog and continuing through charging and billing.

* Build and own the integrated program plan, milestones, dependencies, and critical path across internal teams, our platform vendor, and system integrators.

* Govern the vendor relationship: scope, statements of work, change requests, deliverable acceptance, and contractual milestones.

* Partner with Product and Pricing to define the target catalog model and rationalize legacy plans, promotions, and exceptions.

* Work with Architecture and Engineering on integration design (APIs, channel systems, data flows) and environment strategy.

* Plan and lead data migration, testing strategy (SIT, UAT, performance, parallel billing runs), and cutover and rollback readiness.

* Run RAID management, and escalate early with clear options and recommendations.

* Deliver concise executive reporting and steering-committee materials that drive decisions.

* Drive organizational readiness with Care, Retail, Finance, and Operations so teams and members are prepared for change.

* Define and track success metrics such as time to launch a new offer, billing accuracy, defect rates, and member impact.

**You will need to reside within 50 miles of our Corporate Headquarters in Scottsdale, AZ as this role has the option of hybrid or onsite.**

All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.*

* + 8+ years of program or project management experience, including 5+ years leading technology programs in telecommunications.
* + Proven delivery of at least one large BSS implementation (product catalog, order management, CPQ, or billing) from design through cutover.
* + Experience leading large SaaS or vendor-led implementations, including contract and change-request governance.
* + Hands-on experience planning data migration and production cutover for customer-facing systems.
* + Strong technical fluency in APIs, integration patterns, and cloud/SaaS architecture.
* + Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of influencing senior executives.
* + Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and agile or hybrid delivery methods.
* + Comfort with ambiguity and the confidence to say no, backed by data.
* + Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + Experience with a modern, cloud-native telco BSS platform (Amdocs, Netcracker, Oracle Communications, CSG, Ericsson, Salesforce Communications Cloud).
* + MVNO experience and an understanding of host-network dependencies.
* + Familiarity with TM Forum standards and product-catalog modeling.
* + Background in billing operations, revenue assurance, or financial controls.
* + Experience working with globally distributed vendor teams across time zones.
* + PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification.

Title: Cloud Software Manager
Description:
**About Us**
Dyson is a global technology company that transforms every category it enters where we aim to continue our reputation of being innovative and disruptive. Since our first launch of products in connected space, we have grown fast to several millions of connected machines. As we look toward 2026 and beyond, we are anticipating exponential growth in scale and functionality.
  
  
We want to build reliable, scalable, and secure services and features to support these increasing demands globally with innovative and competitive technologies in IoT, Machine Data Lake, Data Analytics and AI to support our vision.
  
  
We have a ‘You build it, you run it’ ethos and run all our services within Amazon Web Services (AWS). Our teams are responsible for the architecture, development, testing, and operational support of their services in all environments. We are a global department with teams located in the UK, Singapore, and China and we encourage flexible, independent, and innovative thinking in our engineers to deliver solutions. We are now expanding this mission to Dubai based on Build-Operate-Transfer(BOT) model.
  
  
If you thrive on working in a collaborative, stimulating, dynamic environment and relish difficult software engineering challenges then we’d like to speak to you!
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Engineering Manager (Cloud), you will assist in building and leading a Cloud team in Dubai under a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model. Alongside providing strategic leadership and technical mentorship, you will remain hands-on—directly contributing to technical deliverables to ensure the team meets its milestones. You will also work closely with our existing teams in Singapore and China to ensure seamless integration across regions
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Manage the Cloud team in Dubai and foster a supportive and productive environment that leads to success. Oversee the selection / recruitment of key staffs for the team operating under the Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) mode.
* Drive technical execution by being actively involved in technical delivery by actively contributing directly to architecture, code reviews, and development to ensure the team meets critical project milestones and deliver a robust, production-grade cloud services meeting scalability and security.
* Collaborate with Cloud teams from S’pore and the Solution Architect to ensure there is consistent approach and robust support to enable Cloud team to deliver the commitments made to the stakeholders
* Define a clear vision for your team, crafting growth plans that align local talent development with Dyson’s broader organizational goals delivering the Cloud team objectives

**What You Need**

* At least 3 years of experience in managing a team and considerable experience in vendor management.
* Strong knowledge in implementing, designing, building and maintaining scalable Cloud microservices architectures
* Worked with AWS and has hands on experience with deployment and configuration of AWS services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateways, DynamoDB, RDS databases, Redshift, AWS Kinesis, AWS Glue and etc)
* Working knowledge with CI/CD techniques and tooling
* Experience in building production quality cloud services
* Exposure to Agile working practices
* Outstanding communication skills
* An interest in learning new technologies, skills and technique

**Please Apply If You**

* Think this sounds fun
* Want to automate everything
* Like resolving complicated problems
* Have experience with some of our technologies and tools
* Take pride in writing great code
* Have a strong background in software engineering
* Enjoys leading a high-achieving team and releasing innovative designs.

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

Title: Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering
Description:
Questrade is on a mission to help Canadians to become much more financially successful and secure.
  
  
For nearly 30 years, Questrade Financial Group has been delivering on that mission through investing, banking, mortgages, and real estate. Together, we tilt finance in favour of ambitious Canadians, creating new ways for them to seize the financial future they deserve.
  
  
We're looking for people who are ready to enter their career inflection point. Mission-driven, exceptional folks that never settle. The work here is hard because the responsibility is real. If that's the standard you've been looking for, keep reading.
  
  
Req # 4412
  
  
**The return on your career investment**

* Compensation and incentives built to reward the value you bring.
* RRSP matching of up to 6%.
* Health and wellness resources and programs, including $5,000 in mental health practitioner coverage.
* $5,000 in tuition subsidies for job-related courses, every year.
* 100% parental top-up, up to 26 weeks for birthing parents and 18 weeks for non-birthing parents.
* A hybrid environment, with at least three days in the office built for working together.
* Paid vacation, personal, and sick days.
* A community care day to give back to the causes you care about.

*This job posting is for an existing vacancy*
**We’re looking for our next Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering**
We are searching for a Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering to guide, mentor, and scale the engineering squad responsible for our platform stability. At Questrade, we don’t just watch dashboards, we build the intelligence that anticipates failures. Our mission is to achieve absolute reliability and resilience, ensuring our high-frequency trading platforms remain unshakable under the pressure of global markets.
  
  
In this role, you will lead a team of talented SREs who don't just fix problems in Production, they engineer out their possibilities. You are a player-coach and an evangelist for Site/System Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles who views manual toil as a bug to be automated. Most importantly, you will set the technical vision for how your team leverages Machine Learning (ML) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to transform reactive operations into predictive, self-healing systems.
  
  
**The mandate**
**Your Domain: Leading at the Intersection of SRE & AI**
As The Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering Within The Questrade Experience Platform Engineering Group, You Will Balance Hands-on Architectural Leadership With People Management. Your Playground Involves
  
  

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, coach, and grow a squad of System Reliability Engineers. Conduct 1:1s, drive career development, foster a culture of psychological safety and high accountability, and manage capacity across sprint work and on-call rotations.
* SRE Strategy & Governance: Champion SRE best practices across the engineering organization. Guide your team and partner squads in defining and managing SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budgets to balance the velocity of innovation with the necessity of stability.
* AI-Powered Operational Vision: Spearhead the roadmap for applying ML models to "Smart Alerting" and anomaly detection, guiding your team to move beyond static thresholds toward systems that understand patterns and mitigate outages before they happen.
* Autonomous Resilience: Oversee the architecture and implementation of self-healing workflows. Whether it's auto-scaling GKE clusters or building LLM-assisted incident response playbooks, you are steering the development of the "autopilot" for our production environments.
* Cloud Native Excellence: Set the architectural standard for orchestrating highly available systems using GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Terraform, and Helm, ensuring our infrastructure is declarative, versioned, and resilient.
* Executive Incident Command: Serve as an escalation point and Principal Incident Commander during critical, high-severity incidents. Lead cross-functional "War Rooms" with Engineering, DBAs, Network teams, and Executive stakeholders, and champion a blameless post-mortem culture to drive long-term system improvement.
* Domain Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge of trading systems is desired but not required.

**You’re ready for this mandate if you have the following qualifications**
You are a high-level problem solver and inspiring technical leader who bridges the gap between deep systems knowledge, software engineering, and people management.
  
  
**Leadership & Strategic Execution**

* Proven Team Leadership: 7+ years of experience in System Reliability or DevOps engineering, including 2+ years in a formal Team Lead, Tech Lead, or Engineering Management capacity mentoring and managing engineers.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to align engineering squads, product owners, and executive leadership around reliability roadmaps, error budgets, and architectural investments.
* Blameless Culture Builder: You foster an environment where engineers feel safe to experiment, own mistakes, and learn rapidly through rigorous, blameless post-mortems.

**Your Technical Arsenal**

* Automating Support: Strong software engineering background with mastery of Python, C#, and Bash to guide code reviews and build scalable automation frameworks.
* Cloud & Orchestration: Mastery of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE); advanced proficiency in container orchestration and IaC using Kubernetes (kubectl), Helm, and Terraform.
* Modern Observability: Advanced capability in Splunk (Administration/Querying) and Datadog, with experience architecting AI-enhanced observability and dashboards.
* System Versatility: Strong experience with Linux systems and a solid understanding of Windows IIS server, enabling you to guide troubleshooting across a diverse application stack.
* Database & Network Mastery: Strong grasp of MS SQL/MySQL and a deep understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, UDP).

**Mastery of the Incident Lifecycle**

* Incident Command & Escalation: Act as the senior lead during high-severity events, coordinating between Engineering, DBA, Network, and Executive stakeholders to drive rapid service restoration and clear communication.
* The "Resolution First" Mindset: You possess the technical intuition to quickly distinguish between symptoms and root causes under pressure, guiding your team in applying immediate remediation followed by systemic fixes to eliminate technical debt.
* Automated Incident Response: You champion the use of Python, Bash, and AI-driven tools to automate common remediation patterns (e.g., auto-restarting stalled pods, triggering failovers, or clearing cache bottlenecks).
* Predictive Analysis: Lead initiatives using AI and smart alerting to identify "near-misses"—anomalies that didn't cause an outage this time, but will if left unaddressed.

**The SRE Mindset**

* Toil’s Worst Enemy: You relentlessly protect your team's engineering bandwidth by prioritizing the automation of repetitive operational tasks.
* AI Champion: You actively explore and advocate for how Generative AI can summarize logs, accelerate root cause analyses, and elevate internal documentation.
* Resilient Under Pressure: You model calm, decisive leadership in high-pressure trading environments, including managing team on-call rotations and market-critical batch windows.

**Why You’ll Thrive at Questrade**

* Leading the Fintech Frontier: Work at the center of Canada's most innovative brokerage, where your team's reliability directly protects and empowers the financial future of our clients.
* A Culture of Ownership: You aren't a cog; you are a decision-maker. We empower you to shape team strategy, propose architectural shifts, and lead high-impact technical investments.
* Infinite Learning: We don't just support your growth—we demand it. From AI workshops and leadership development to advanced cloud certifications, you and your team will be constantly evolving.

***Enter your career inflection point. Apply now.***

We mix human ingenuity with advanced technology. For ambitious builders like you, we provide the latest technology to enable your creativity. You'll have everything you need to build the best outcomes and products for our clients.

Title: Incident Manager
Description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is looking for an **Incident Manager** to join our Team. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills, with excellent time management and attention to detail. Effective written and verbal communication skills are key, with strong critical-thinking abilities, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as a team. These qualities are essential to successfully managing and resolving high-priority incidents in a fast-paced environment.

  

**Work Location:** This is a remote position with core working hours of 8am – 5pm EST

  

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the coordination and management of impacting incidents to ensure timely service restoration while minimizing disruption to customers and business operations.
* Execute the enterprise Incident Management process, including monitoring incident queues, prioritizing incidents, and coordinating escalations to drive timely resolution.
* Facilitate the global response and coordination of major incidents affecting mission-critical business applications and infrastructure services in a 24/7/365 environment.
* Lead major incident communications by providing timely, accurate, and consistent updates to customers, stakeholders, and leadership throughout the incident life-cycle.
* Review and validate major incident notifications to ensure communications are complete, accurate, and appropriate for the intended audience.
* Leverage incident and problem management tools to track incidents, maintain detailed incident logs, document resolutions, and prepare reports for management review.
* Apply technical knowledge across infrastructure, applications, security, and performance management to support incident investigation and resolution.
* Collaborate with technical teams, Service Desk personnel, and other stakeholders to troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues and drive incidents toward resolution.
* Identify recurring incidents and potential trends, partnering with Problem Management teams to support root cause analysis and prevent future disruptions.
* Drive continuous improvement of the Incident Management life-cycle, including incident response procedures, escalation processes, and post-incident reviews.
* Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, operational procedures, and process guidelines for the Incident Management team.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across the organization to support critical incidents, including high-profile business events and time-sensitive operations.
* Remain composed and effective in high-pressure situations while managing competing priorities and coordinating multiple teams during critical incidents.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and provide incident management support outside of standard business hours, as needed, to ensure 24/7 service coverage.
* Maintain flexibility in work schedule to support business needs and incident response requirements.

**Problem Management**

* Engage with and assist the Problem Management team during Problem Investigations
* Utilize problem management reports to validate if any open problem known errors when handling high-priority incidents.
* Proactively and reactively, look for solutions to prevent problems from occurring in team/technology area.

**Change Management/Implementation**

* Utilize change management reports during a high-priority incident to validate if incident could be caused by change.
* Independently review, implement, and verify changes/solutions of high complexity and risk to meet customer and/or trade/IT infrastructure needs.
* May participate in a Change Advisory Board.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Becoming a trusted advisor to the customer.

**Teamwork**

* Work as part of a team, which may be virtual, global, and/or multi-functional.
* Lead teams which address operational processes and policies in work area.
* Seen as a resource to the team in one or more technical or business areas.
* Becoming a trusted advisor inside and outside the team/technology area.

##### **Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
* Must be willing to undergo a pre-employment credit check as required by the Customer.
* Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of experience, a Master's Degree and 3 years of experience, an Associate's Degree and 7 years of experience, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years of experience
* 3+ years of relevant experience in Customer Service, Incident Management, or general project management
* Familiarity and understanding of IT Service Management tools (Remedy, JIRA, ServiceNow, etc.)
* Working knowledge of the technology, applications, and infrastructure within areas of responsibility
* Ability to effectively coordinate technical teams during incident investigation and resolution
* Developing and maintaining relationships with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication, collaboration, and coordination throughout the incident management life-cycle
* Proficiency with MS Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ITIL Foundations Certification
* One or more of the following Incident Response related certifications: Threat Handling Foundations certificate, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), Practical SOC Analyst Associate (PSAA), OffSec Incident Responder (OSIR), or Certified Incident Handler (ECIH)

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Title: Sr. Manager Imaging- Service Delivery
Description:
The Manager, Service Delivery owns the implementation portfolio for Merge— the delivery outcomes that portfolio produces and the Implementation Project Managers who execute it. This role carries the portfolio's utilization and revenue mandate, assigns coverage across active engagements, and holds the delivery standard the rest of the organization plans against.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Mandate & strategic focus**

* Own end-to-end delivery of implementations across an assigned portfolio spanning cloud, on-premises, and hybrid deployments.
* Set the portfolio's delivery approach — engagement sequencing, resource assignment, and readiness gates — against customer commitments and product availability.
* Partner across Sales, Support, Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to align scope, handoffs, and escalation paths, and validate effort estimates and staffing feasibility during pre-sales scoping.
* Shape the implementation methodology, project templates, and readiness criteria the broader Professional Services organization delivers against.

**Performance & outcomes**

* Deliver committed scope on plan across the portfolio, hitting target billable utilization and on-schedule revenue recognition against active statements of work.
* Enforce delivery discipline on every engagement — approved plan, documented scope, tracked risks, current status, and clean transition to Support — and report portfolio health, schedule adherence, and forecast accuracy.
* Drive out-of-scope requests to a change order or documented decline, and bring rate, margin, and staffing-mix decisions to the Director with data-backed recommendations.

**Relationships, influence, & judgment**

* Own the customer relationship at the project-sponsor level, leading executive communication on at-risk engagements and escalated issues with speed and urgency.
* Lead the highest-visibility go-lives directly, ensuring readiness criteria, command-center coverage, and rollback plans are in place before cutover.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customer leadership on implementation best practices and operational readiness, holding credible technical ground on architecture, integration, and data migration.

**Team building & capability**

* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team of Implementation Project Managers, setting clear expectations, direct feedback, and individual development plans.
* Assign project managers and supporting resources to engagements based on complexity, product mix, customer profile, and individual capability.
* Drive enablement and performance practices at the team and individual level, modeling the delivery standard the organization aligns to.

**Other**

* Maintain accurate delivery data in the PSA and CRM platforms so portfolio reporting is reliable without rework, and support ongoing improvement of Professional Services processes, tools, and methodology.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Core Competencies**

* Drives engagements to closure through ambiguity, competing priorities, and dependencies outside direct control.
* Holds credible ground in technical discussion covering system architecture, infrastructure, integrations, and data migration.
* Communicates status, risk, and recovery plans candidly to hospital executives and internal leadership without softening bad news.
* Coaches project managers on judgment, customer presence, and delivery rigor, raising team capability measurably over time.
* Makes timely decisions with incomplete information, weighing customer commitment, delivery cost, and precedent.
* Manages by evidence, maintaining a predictable operating cadence and current data across the portfolio.
* Reads customer organizations accurately, identifying the real decision makers, the political constraints, and the unstated risks.
* Holds the line on scope, process, and standards under pressure from customers and internal stakeholders.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years delivering enterprise software or healthcare IT implementation projects in a customer-facing capacity.

Title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, USA)
Description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

*This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).*

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

### **About our platform**

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

### **About the Infrastructure group**

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

### **How we work**

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
* Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
* Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
* Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
* Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
* Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
* Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
* Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
------------------------------

* Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
* Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
* Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
* A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
* The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
* Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
* You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
* Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

**Bonus Points For**
--------------------

* Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
* Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
* Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
* Running observability for a production platform at scale
* Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
* You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In the USA, the base compensation range for this role is $189,374 - $227,249. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

#LI-Remote

**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**

* **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

* **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

* **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* **In-Person onboarding** - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* **Balance is Key** - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.*

Title: NOC Manager
Description:

At
**Bandwidth**
, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on,
*the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful.*
And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next?
**#JoinTheBand**

**What We Are Looking For:**

As a
**NOC Manager,**
you will be an instrumental part of Bandwidth.com’s Network Operations Center (NOC). The ideal candidate will ensure that the NOC drives issues to resolution, and the team meets all of it’s KPI’s. This is a role that requires individuals to lead a team to successfully meets its objectives, all while working in a complex troubleshooting environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* Supervise a 24x7x365 NOC shift and personnel that monitors, troubleshoots and repairs service-impacting network issues.
* Manage a team of technicians, providing guidance and mentorship, while ensuring that team obligations are met.
* Oversee day-to-day NOC operations, escalations, ticketing and communications.
* Ensure that issues impacting company production infrastructure, systems, and applications are being driven to resolution.
* Identify areas for process and efficiency improvement within the team.
* Create documentation around new workflows, and ensure that training is provided for internal team members.
* Serve as part of the escalation path for internal and external network issues.
* Gather reporting on network Service Level Agreements (SLA’s) and team Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s), and ensure that these metrics are being met.
* Review team member tickets for quality, ensuring that due diligence is being performed, and that standard operating procedures are being followed.
* Oversee network repair and after-hours maintenance activity (switch, transport and trunks).
* Will be part of a rotating management on-call schedule.
* While on-call, subject to receiving call outs 24 hours, 7 days a week.
* Participate in strategic planning sessions related to infrastructure, product launches, and network readiness.
* Represent the NOC in executive updates, audits, or customer reviews.
* Support special projects, organizational change initiatives, or process redesigns as needed.

**What You Need:**

* Education:
  + Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience:
  + 6+ years of experience in network or service operations, with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role.
  + Demonstrated success managing multi-shift or multi-site operational teams in a 24x7 environment.
* Knowledge:
  + Strong understanding of ITIL or equivalent service management frameworks.
  + Deep familiarity with incident, change, and problem management processes.
  + Working knowledge of network monitoring, infrastructure operations, and service delivery models.
* Skills:
  + Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams and managers.
  + Excellent analytical, communication, and decision-making skills.
  + Strong organizational and planning abilities, with a focus on metrics and performance outcomes.
  + Capable of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives with minimal oversight.

**Bonus Points:**

* Education:
  + Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience:
  + Experience leading NOC modernization or automation initiatives.
  + Background in telecommunications, SaaS, or large-scale network service environments.
* Knowledge:
  + Familiarity with observability platforms, cloud networking, and DevOps practices.
  + Advanced understanding of workforce optimization and capacity planning methodologies.
* Skills:
  + Strategic thinking and change management.
  + Skilled in influencing without authority across diverse technical and business teams.
  + Competence in data storytelling and executive-level reporting.

**The Whole Person Promise:**

At Bandwidth, we’re pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our “Whole Person Promise.” We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

* 100% company-paid Medical, Vision, & Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out-of-pocket expenses.
* All new hires receive four weeks of PTO.
