Title: INNOVATION AND TECHNOLOGY NETWORK MANAGER - (NON-CLASSIFIED) *
Description:
The Position
  
  
The City of Riverside, Innovation and Technology Department (IT) is accepting applications for the position of
**INNOVATION AND TECHNOLOGY NETWORK MANAGER to**
fill one (1) vacancy in the
**Network Division**
**.**
The eligibility list established may be used to fill the current and/or upcoming vacancies within this classification for up to six 6 months.
  
  
The Network Manager position will lead and perform advanced-level network administration and operational oversight as part of the City's Network Team, supporting the daily availability, performance, and security of enterprise-wide communications infrastructure that includes WAN/LAN, data center, wireless, voice, and public safety networks. This role is responsible for coordinating day-to-day network operations such as monitoring and responding to alerts, troubleshooting and resolving escalated incidents, managing configurations and change activities, overseeing backups and redundancy, maintaining network documentation and standards, and coordinating vendor support and carrier services. In addition, the Network Manager will guide and mentor technical staff, collaborate closely with other IT teams and City departments, and ensure networks supporting cameras, radio systems, and mission-critical applications remain highly available, secure, and compliant, while also contributing to longer-term planning, upgrades, and modernization initiatives to meet the evolving needs of City services and the community
  
  
Under general supervision, the Innovation and Technology Network Manager is to plan, organize and direct information technology functions related to Networking, Data Center Operation, and Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Management Applications and to perform related work as required.
  
  

* Actual job classification is Innovation and Technology Officer II (Non-Classified). Positions designated as non-classified are exempt from the classified service. The incumbent will be appointed "at-will" and serve at the pleasure of the City Manager.

**For positions indicating a salary range from 1N – 2X, the top 15% of the pay range cannot be offered upon hire or upon an employee promotion.**
Work Performed
  
  
Typical duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Develop and implement project plans to accomplish work group objectives and assign work and monitor performance. Take action in the full range of formal personnel activities, and provide contract oversight in conjunction within the Innovation and Technology Department.
* Provide subject matter expertise in highly complex mission critical enterprise-wide systems which require expertise in multiple industry areas.
* Prepare, negotiate and present budget and other funding proposals; monitor expenditures and operate within budget allocation.
* Develop strategic plans and implement operational plans to provide information technology infrastructure to support the City's/Department's business goals; and oversee one or more of the following technical areas: Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Manager Applications, Networking, and Data Center Operations.

When assigned to Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Management Applications:
  
  

* Manage all activities related to the design, development and implementation of information systems and software applications.
* Oversee maintenance, support and upgrade of existing systems and applications.
* Confirm software integration into existing systems, meets functional requirements, systems compliance and interface specifications.
* Design, develop, and install enhancements and upgrades to systems and application software.
* Compile and maintain an inventory of all software and system assets, and corresponding contracts and agreements.
* Develop training materials for end users and conduct training as necessary.

**When Assigned To Networking**

* Plan, coordinate and supervise activities of a complex communications infrastructure, including radio, microwave and wireless communications, voice services, including WAN/LAN technology, switches, routers and fiber optics, and supporting management applications.
* Plan, coordinate and supervise activities of over 1,000 security cameras.
* Establish schedules and internal controls to meet deadlines.
* Manage city-owned or leased equipment and line and service installation and expansion.
* Identify areas for improvement and implement and maintain new or improved services to meet changing technical and customer requirements.
* Review, evaluate and recommend telecommunications hardware and software packages.

**When Assigned To Data Center Operations**

* Plan, coordinate and supervise the enterprise computing services including messaging and collaboration software including, email, unified communications, servers, desktop and server virtualization technologies, enterprise desktop management tools, data storage and backup infrastructure, Active Directory, VPN and system monitoring tools.
* Design and implement short and long-term strategic plans to ensure system capacity meets existing and future requirements.
* Ensure a high level of application, server and storage, and enterprise system availability.
* Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures, and associated training plans for related infrastructure operations.
* Plan the acquisition and installation of hardware equipment, applicable enterprise system software and maintenance agreements.
* Maintain data center facilities.
* Assist with the planning and deployment of server, storage infrastructure and enterprise system security measures.
* Develop, implement and maintain an efficient, well documented disaster recovery plan.

**Qualifications**
**OPTION I:**

* Education: A Master's degree in computer science, information systems or public/business administration.
* Experience: Three years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing, and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Ii**

* Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering, voice/data communications, public/business administration or a related field.
* Experience: Four years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Iii**

* Education: Associate of Arts degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering voice/data communications, public/business administration or related field.
* Experience: Six years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Iv**

* Education: Equivalent of the completion of the twelfth grade.
* Experience: Eight years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Necessary Special Qualifications**

* When assigned to the Police Department, must be able to successfully pass an extensive police background.

**Network Manager Highly Desirables**

* Enterprise Network Architecture and Engineering: Advanced experience designing, implementing, and managing large-scale WAN/LAN environments, including routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, fiber-optic infrastructure, wireless networking, network segmentation, SD-WAN, and enterprise connectivity.
* Network Leadership and Staff Development: Proven success managing technical teams, establishing performance expectations, delegating responsibilities, mentoring employees, addressing performance deficiencies, and maintaining accountability for operational and project outcomes.
* Project Management and Strategic Planning: Demonstrated ability to independently plan, budget, coordinate, and deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing competing priorities, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and long-term technology modernization strategies.
* Operational Excellence and Infrastructure Lifecycle Management: Extensive experience establishing and enforcing network operational standards, preventive maintenance programs, patch management, change control procedures, hardware lifecycle planning, asset management, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* Network Security, Resiliency, and Business Continuity: Strong background implementing enterprise security controls, firewalls, Zero Trust principles, secure connectivity, redundancy, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions supporting mission-critical services.
* Financial, Procurement, and Vendor Management: Proven experience developing and managing technology budgets, evaluating procurement requirements, administering vendor contracts, monitoring service-level agreements, validating deliverables, and maintaining financial accountability.
* Communication, Collaboration, and Organizational Accountability: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated success proactively communicating project status, identifying and escalating risks, maintaining follow-through, coordinating across departments, and presenting technical information to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Enterprise Monitoring, Troubleshooting, and Continuous Improvement: Advanced experience managing enterprise network monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, performance optimization, capacity planning, network automation, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Public Safety and Mission-Critical Infrastructure: Experience managing complex networking environments supporting public safety communications, radio and microwave systems, surveillance cameras, telecommunications, fiber infrastructure, and other essential 24/7 government or enterprise services.

Title: IT Infrastructure Manager - Network, Server & Azure
Description:
We are seeking an experienced IT Operations Manager to lead the design, operation, security, and continual improvement of Daniels Health’s core technology infrastructure. This role owns the enterprise network, server and hybrid infrastructure environment, and Microsoft Azure tenant, ensuring these platforms are reliable, secure, scalable, well-governed, and aligned with business requirements across global entities.
  
  
The IT Operations Manager is accountable for the operational health and strategic evolution of on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. This includes network connectivity, firewalls, wireless, servers, virtualization, storage, backup and disaster recovery, Microsoft Azure services, identity and access integrations, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure lifecycle management. The role partners closely with Cybersecurity, Service Desk, Applications/Development, and business stakeholders to provide secure, resilient technology services for field, operations, and office personnel, both remote and onsite.
  
  
This position combines people leadership, hands-on technical depth, vendor management, operational governance, and project delivery. The successful candidate will establish clear ownership, standards, documentation, performance measures, and roadmaps for the infrastructure estate.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the operational performance, availability, capacity, security, and lifecycle management of enterprise network, server, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure.
* Lead and develop infrastructure personnel, contractors, and managed service providers; establish clear priorities, expectations, accountability, technical standards, and development plans.
* Design, implement, maintain, and continually improve resilient network services, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, internet connectivity, firewalls, wireless, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and network segmentation.
* Own server and compute platforms, including Windows and Linux servers, virtualization, storage, file and print services, directory services, and supporting infrastructure components.
* Own the Microsoft Azure tenant and associated platform services, including subscriptions, resource organization, governance, networking, compute, storage, backup, monitoring, cost management, and role-based access controls.
* Manage hybrid connectivity and integrations among Azure, on-premises infrastructure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, SaaS platforms, and business applications.
* Establish and maintain infrastructure monitoring, alerting, health checks, performance baselines, capacity planning, and operational reporting.
* Ensure infrastructure changes are properly planned, reviewed, tested, documented, communicated, and implemented in accordance with change-management and security requirements.

Security, Resilience, and Compliance
  
  

* Partner with the Cybersecurity team to implement and operate secure infrastructure configurations, identity controls, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, logging, endpoint/server hardening, and privileged-access practices.
* Ensure timely patching and remediation for servers, network devices, Azure services, and supporting infrastructure, using risk-based prioritization and documented exceptions where necessary.
* Own backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery capabilities for infrastructure services; conduct and document regular restoration and failover tests.
* Develop, maintain, and test business continuity and disaster-recovery procedures for critical infrastructure platforms.
* Maintain accurate network diagrams, infrastructure inventories, configuration standards, runbooks, recovery procedures, and technical documentation.
* Ensure infrastructure practices support applicable company security, privacy, compliance, and audit requirements.

Architecture, Projects, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Develop and maintain a multi-year infrastructure roadmap covering network modernization, server and virtualization lifecycle, Azure adoption, security enhancements, resilience, and technical debt reduction.
* Lead infrastructure projects from requirements through design, implementation, transition to operations, and post-implementation review.
* Evaluate infrastructure technologies, service providers, licensing models, and architecture options; recommend solutions based on business value, reliability, security, scalability, and total cost of ownership.
* Manage infrastructure vendors, carriers, cloud providers, hardware suppliers, and managed service partners; hold vendors accountable to contractual obligations and service levels.
* Drive standardization, automation, and operational maturity through infrastructure-as-code where appropriate, scripting, repeatable deployment practices, and streamlined support processes.
* Establish and report meaningful operational KPIs, including platform availability, incident trends, patch compliance, backup success, recovery testing, capacity, project delivery, service performance, and Azure spend.
* Collaborate with the Service Desk to ensure effective escalation paths, knowledge transfer, service transition, and timely resolution of infrastructure-related incidents.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, including network, server, cloud, or hybrid environments.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in an infrastructure, systems, network, cloud operations, or IT operations management capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams, vendors, managed service providers, or complex infrastructure projects.
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise network services across multiple sites and remote users.
* Experience administering and governing Microsoft Azure environments in a production enterprise setting.
* Experience with server administration, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, patch management, and infrastructure lifecycle planning.
* Experience effectively communicating cross-functionally and with stakeholders at varying levels of the organization.

Technical Proficiencies
  
  

* Proven experience as an IT Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, or Operations Manager, with the ability to lead, mentor, and hold technical personnel accountable.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, wireless, WAN/SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP, network segmentation, and network troubleshooting.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including tenant/subscription governance, resource groups, virtual networks, network security controls, Azure Virtual Machines, storage, backup, monitoring, policy, cost management, and role-based access control.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and Entra ID integrations, Group Policy, virtualization platforms, storage, backup and recovery, and core infrastructure services.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, identity and access management, endpoint management, and hybrid cloud architecture.
* Experience with infrastructure monitoring and management tools, log management, vulnerability-management processes, and reporting platforms such as Power BI and Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, and service-transition management. Experience with Freshservice, ServiceNow, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Experience managing infrastructure vendors, telecommunications providers, cloud service providers, licensing, contracts, and renewals.
* Ability to translate business requirements into secure, supportable, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions.

Professional Competencies
  
  

* Ability to see the broader contribution of infrastructure services to business continuity, productivity, customer service, cybersecurity, and growth.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and lead coordinated responses to major incidents.
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, options, and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Dynamic and innovative approach to problem solving, operational improvement, and technology modernization.
* Diligent in following and improving security, compliance, documentation, and change-control processes.
* Commitment to high-quality service, operational excellence, ownership, and continual improvement.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or comparable Azure certification.
* Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or comparable network certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher.
* Security, cloud, virtualization, or disaster-recovery certifications relevant to the environment.

Title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization
Description:
**Job Description**

  

**Vacancy Status:** This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

**AI Disclosure:** As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

  

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

  

The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on technology leader with a track record of operating and modernizing complex enterprise data environments. They can lead multidisciplinary teams across data engineering, business analysis, data quality, and governance; align business and technology stakeholders around a clear modernization roadmap; and deliver large-scale migration while protecting the reliability of existing services. They understand how to build trusted, well-governed data foundations that enable enterprise-wide analytics and AI adoption.

  

**The Role**
------------

As the Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization, you will lead the team responsible for the day-to-day health and continued operation of the existing enterprise data warehouse, as well as its modernization and migration to a cloud-based environment. You will set direction, establish delivery and operational priorities, and ensure the platform evolves to meet the needs of GM Canada and the wider enterprise.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team comprising three Data Engineering, Cloud Migration & Platforms Engineers; one Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration; one Data Validation & Data Quality Analyst, Enterprise Data; and one Data Governance Analyst. You will bring these capabilities together into a coordinated operating model that delivers reliable services, high-quality and well-governed data, and a successful migration. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating priorities for the enterprise data environment, balancing current service needs with modernization and migration objectives.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team across data engineering, business analysis, data validation and quality, and data governance; clarify accountability, establish expectations, and support professional growth.
* Maintain the reliability, availability, performance, security, and supportability of the existing enterprise data warehouse and its critical data pipelines.
* Lead the planning and execution of the enterprise data warehouse migration to a cloud-based environment, including scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks, resourcing, milestones, and business readiness.
* Direct modernization of data architecture, platforms, pipelines, processes, and controls to improve scalability, automation, resilience, maintainability, and cost effectiveness.
* Establish a practical transition strategy that protects business continuity, manages legacy and cloud coexistence, and ensures migrated workloads and data meet agreed operational and business requirements.
* Ensure migration outcomes are validated through appropriate testing, reconciliation, data-quality controls, business acceptance, and production-readiness reviews.
* Set expectations for engineering standards and practices, including architecture, automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, testing, observability, incident response, and documentation.
* Establish and oversee data-quality practices that monitor completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and schema conformance across source, pipeline, and warehouse data.
* Lead data governance practices that support clear ownership, stewardship, definitions, metadata, lineage, access controls, classification, retention, and responsible use of enterprise data.
* Build trusted relationships with business leaders, GM Canada stakeholders, enterprise data consumers, technology partners, security and risk teams, and global platform organizations.
* Translate business priorities into a sequenced and measurable data roadmap, ensuring stakeholder needs and downstream impacts are represented in decisions.
* Oversee requirements management, backlog priorities, sprint and release planning, delivery tracking, risk and issue management, and cross-team dependencies.
* Establish clear measures of success for platform health, service reliability, migration progress, data quality, governance, delivery outcomes, and customer or business impact.
* Ensure operational procedures, support models, escalation paths, service expectations, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place for both legacy and cloud environments.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and data-informed decision-making across the team.
* Guide the development of secure, trusted, discoverable, and well-documented data foundations that can support analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise-wide AI adoption.
Communicate progress, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders and delivery partners.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant progressive experience leading enterprise data, data engineering, data platforms, technology modernization, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex, enterprise-scale data or technology initiatives.
* Experience operating and modernizing enterprise data warehouses and production data platforms, preferably including Oracle-based environments.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale data platform or warehouse migrations, from assessment and planning through implementation, validation, and operational transition.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, data integration, ETL/ELT, cloud data platforms, data quality, and enterprise data operations.
* Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, quality, reliability, and operational practices for business-critical data environments.
* Ability to set strategic direction while maintaining sufficient technical depth to evaluate architecture, delivery approaches, risks, and trade-offs.
* Strong business and financial judgment, with the ability to prioritize work and resources against enterprise outcomes and operational needs.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills, including the ability to align senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong change leadership skills and the ability to guide teams and stakeholders through complex modernization while sustaining current operations.
* Experience with Agile or iterative delivery models, portfolio or roadmap planning, and management of complex cross-functional dependencies.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and risk-management capabilities.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience leading an on-premises Oracle data warehouse migration to Azure, Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Synapse, or equivalent enterprise data and lakehouse technologies.
* Familiarity with cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data pipeline automation, and cloud operations.
* Experience establishing data observability, automated data-quality controls, reconciliation practices, and operational scorecards.
* Experience leading data governance and stewardship programs, including cataloging, lineage, classification, data ownership, and access management.
* Experience modernizing data platforms and operating models to support advanced analytics, machine learning, or enterprise AI use cases.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed, regulated, or security-sensitive enterprise environment.
Familiarity with enterprise tools and practices for Agile delivery, service management, documentation, and operational monitoring.  

**Compensation:**

Title: DIRECTOR, INFORMATION SECURITY OPERATIONS
Description:

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.

At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

Title: Network Systems Manager
Description:
The Network Systems Manager oversees the daily operational engineering, maintenance, management, and continuous optimization of the enterprise network infrastructure supporting the Air Force National Capital Region (AFNCR). This role ensures maximum network uptime, robust cybersecurity enforcement, and seamless mission-critical data transport across both unclassified (NIPR) and classified (SIPR/JWICS) secure enclaves
  
  
The Manager provides senior-level technical direction and leadership to a team of engineers and technicians, ensuring full alignment with Department of Defense (DoD) regulations and program objectives.
  
  
Since 1976, SMS has specialized in modernizing legacy IT and sustaining complex enterprise environments for federal agencies. With the goal of building long-term partnerships with our customers, we invest in our employees by providing the training, tools, and support they need to keep critical missions operational, improve performance, and reduce risk. SMS is headquartered in McLean, Virginia, with offices and on-site operations at customer locations throughout the United States. For additional information on SMS, visit www.sms.com.
  
  
Submit your resume today!
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Infrastructure Management: Oversee the configuration, deployment, optimization, and lifecycle management of core data center and enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure, including Cisco Nexus and Catalyst switches, routers, F5 Load Balancers, and Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
* Operational Leadership: Manage a specialized team of network engineers and operations center specialists; coordinate shift logs, escalate tickets, and lead complex troubleshooting across physical, virtual, and transport layers.
* Security & Compliance: Enforce physical and logical cybersecurity measures in strict adherence to DoD regulations. Ensure network baselines maintain STIG compliance, support Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) remediation, and provide technical artifacts for RMF accreditation.
* Access Control & Crypto: Manage enterprise network systems utilizing Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco Catalyst Center for automated access control, device profiling, and policy enforcement. Support TACLANE/HAIPE encryptors (e.g., KG-175D) to secure sensitive data-in-transit.
* Performance Monitoring: Utilize telemetry and network monitoring tools (such as Cacti or other SNMP-based software) to closely track system capacity, application availability, and overall environmental health
* Documentation & Governance: Develop, enforce, and audit detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), network topology maps, rack layouts, and precise asset tracking databases
* Stakeholder Liaison: Serve as a primary technical contact for government stakeholders, Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), and prime program leadership regarding network upgrades and configuration modifications.

**Required Qualifications**

* CCNA required, CCNP preferred
* Active DoD Secret security clearance
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field (Equivalent professional experience may be substituted on a 2-for-1 basis)
* Experience: Minimum of 8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering, network operations, or infrastructure support, with at least 2–3 years in a team lead, supervisory, or management capacity within a secure federal defense or intelligence environment.
* Network Access Control: Experience designing, implementing, operating, and maintaining IEEE 802.1X authentication and network access control solutions using Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), including integration with wired network infrastructure, identity sources, endpoint profiling, policy administration, and troubleshooting authentication and authorization issues.
* Application Delivery and Access Management: Experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting F5 BIG-IP Load Balancers, including Local Traffic Manager (LTM) and Access Policy Manager (APM) modules. Experience should include virtual servers, pools, health monitors, traffic policies, SSL/TLS configuration, high availability, and access-policy configuration.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Demonstrate experience managing automated network configuration workflows and software-defined network spaces.
* Familiarity with deploying multicast-based platforms (such as IPTV architectures) across enterprise local area networks.
* Exceptional communication skills, with a proven track record of managing interdisciplinary cleared teams and translating complex technical details into executive-level briefs.

**Salary Range - $130,000 - $175,000**

* Lead, coach, and develop the infrastructure & networking team; assign priorities, establish performance expectations, build technical depth, and foster accountability and responsive service.
* Manage service relationships and incident collaboration with managed service providers, network carriers, infrastructure suppliers, external cybersecurity and managed security service providers, and other partners; monitor SLAs, escalations, and unresolved actions.

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience; typically 7+ years in infrastructure/network engineering or operations with demonstrated team leadership.

* Working knowledge of cybersecurity operations, vulnerabilities, access management, infrastructure hardening, security alerts, and SOC collaboration.
* Effective people leadership, vendor/SLA management, technical documentation, prioritization, and communication with both technical and business audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Specialized Skills / Other Requirements**

* Experience with managed network security/SOC services; familiarity with SIEM and security monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of GxP, validated-system change controls, ISO 13485, and business continuity practices; relevant Microsoft, Cisco, security, or infrastructure certifications.

Leadership Competencies & Success Measures
  
  
Success requires ownership, sound technical judgment, calm incident leadership, people development, cross-functional influence, transparent communication, a security-first mindset, and continuous improvement. Performance is measured by site/network and platform availability; incident response and recovery; Microsoft service reliability; backup and restore test results; vulnerability and security-alert remediation timeliness; documented root cause and corrective action completion; site standardization; partner SLA performance; and team effectiveness.

Description:
****Job Title: Network Manager****
****Team: Infrastructure****
****Job Location: Remote****
**About Us**
Join us in revolutionizing healthcare! We build software that simplifies the process of choosing the right health insurance for individuals. Our solutions help our health plan and government customers with the administration, reporting, and operational requirements of their plans. By tackling the complexities of enrollment, administration, renewal, billing, and more, we enable our customers and partners to concentrate on advancing their core missions.
  
  
**Our Company Culture**
Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and appreciation. We value each employee's unique talents and contributions and understand that every individual plays a critical role in our mission to transform healthcare. Every day, we celebrate our team's dedication, creativity, and expertise, which drive us closer to our goals.
  
  
At Softheon, our mission is making healthcare more affordable, accessible, and plentiful for every American. Our vision is that everyone can access and choose the healthcare they need.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Network Manager is a hands-on technical and people leader responsible for managing and maintaining Softheon's network infrastructure. This role combines day-to-day network engineering and operational responsibilities with team leadership, ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of network systems across on-premises and cloud environments.
  
  
The Network Manager will work directly in the network environment, troubleshooting complex issues, implementing network solutions, supporting projects, and identifying opportunities for improvement. This role will lead and develop network team members while partnering with Infrastructure, Security, and other teams to ensure network services meet organizational needs.
  
  
*Please note that the requirements of this role are beyond the 9am - 6pm scope. It is expected that all leaders are available to the organization when needed.*
**Requirements**
You Will:
  
  
**Network Operations & Engineering**

* Own the design, architecture, and overall health of Softheon's network infrastructure, proactively identifying and addressing risks, capacity needs, and opportunities for improvement; operate with a high degree of autonomy and serve as the primary technical owner, escalating critical issues to leadership as needed
* Manage and maintain Softheon's network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments
* Configure, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, wireless networks, and related technologies
* Perform hands-on network configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization
* Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity and proactively address potential issues
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex network incidents and service interruptions
* Participate in critical incident response, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning
* Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures
* Perform regular network maintenance, upgrades, and configuration changes
* Support the implementation and maintenance of network monitoring and management tools
* Ensure network infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and aligned with established technical and security standards

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Manage and provide day-to-day leadership to network team members
* Assign work, establish priorities, and monitor progress to ensure network activities and projects are completed effectively
* Provide technical guidance and support to team members when troubleshooting complex network issues
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide feedback, and support employee development
* Promote knowledge sharing, collaboration, accountability, and effective communication within the network team
* Establish and maintain team processes and procedures that support efficient network operations
* Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for the network team
* Manage and oversee the team's on-call rotation, ensuring appropriate coverage, clear escalation procedures, and timely response to after-hours network incidents

**Network Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain network security controls in partnership with the Security Team
* Configure and maintain firewalls, VPNs, access controls, network segmentation, and other network security technologies
* Identify, investigate, and address network vulnerabilities and security risks
* Support security assessments, audits, and remediation activities related to network infrastructure
* Ensure network changes and configurations follow established security, compliance, and change management requirements
* Support compliance requirements related to network infrastructure and organizational security standards

**Projects & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead and participate in network infrastructure projects from planning through implementation
* Support network upgrades, migrations, implementations, and infrastructure improvements
* Evaluate network technologies and solutions to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive network processes and improve operational workflows
* Develop and implement improvements to network processes, documentation, and procedures
* Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud, and other technical teams on cross-functional technical initiatives
* Assist with planning and prioritizing network-related projects based on organizational and operational needs

V
**endor & Stakeholder Management**

* Work with network technology vendors and service providers to troubleshoot issues and support network initiatives
* Serve as the primary subject matter expert for network technologies, vendors, and solutions, providing technical leadership and recommendations for network procurement, vendor selection, and technology investments.
* Lead network procurement activities, including evaluating solutions and vendors, defining technical requirements, conducting technical assessments, negotiating technical considerations, and making recommendations to ensure solutions meet Softheon's operational, security, scalability, and business needs
* Monitor vendor performance and escalate issues as needed
* Communicate network issues, risks, project updates, and recommendations to Infrastructure leadership and relevant stakeholders
* Partner with other technical teams to ensure network solutions effectively support organizational requirements

**Talent Management**

* Collaborate with the Talent team to actively engage in the hiring and recruitment process, including but not limited to participating in interviews
* Leverage industry networks and expertise to identify and attract top talent that aligns with the company's objectives and values.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to team members within your department and across diverse functions.
* Play an integral role in shaping and reinforcing the overall company culture, promoting values that enhance teamwork, collaboration, and employee engagement

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Own and participate in the team's 24/7 network support and on-call operations, including developing team capabilities, establishing and managing the on-call rotation, ensuring appropriate coverage and escalation procedures, and personally responding to network issues and critical incidents as part of the on-call rotation
* Although we work in a remote-first environment, all roles require in-person attendance at our headquarters approximately 2 times per year (in addition to other travel requirements for this specific role, if applicable). These visits are essential for team collaboration, strategic planning, and fostering deeper connections across the organization. Travel arrangements will be supported to ensure a seamless experience.
* Must reside in the Eastern or Central time zone. Must be located in one of the following states: AL, AR, CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, WI
* 10% travel may be required

You Have
  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required

**Experience**

* At least 5 years of professional experience in network engineering, network administration, or a related network infrastructure role
* At least 1 year of experience managing, supervising, or leading a technical or network team
* Hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments
* Experience supporting network projects, upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure improvements
* Experience with network monitoring, troubleshooting, and critical incident response

**Required Certifications:**

* Must have either the CCIE or CCNP

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
* Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
* Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
* Other relevant networking or security certifications

**Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, BGP, and OSPF
* Knowledge of Cisco networking technologies and NGINX
* Knowledge of firewalls, VPNs, network security, and network segmentation
* Working knowledge of cloud networking, particularly Azure and/or AWS
* Knowledge of ITIL practices for incident, problem, and change management
* Required: Hands-on experience with Cisco Firepower and ASA firewalls.
* Required: Experience with Dell OS10 and SonicOS networking platforms.
* Preferred: Experience with NGINX.
* Preferred: Experience with Cloudflare

**Skills**

* Strong hands-on network configuration, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple technical issues and projects
* Ability to lead a team while remaining actively involved in day-to-day technical operations
* Strong communication, technical documentation, and collaboration skills
* Ability to analyze network performance and identify opportunities for improvement

**Attributes**

* Hands-on and technically engaged
* Strong people leader with a focus on accountability, collaboration, and employee development
* Proactive, solutions-oriented, and detail-oriented
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Adaptable and committed to continuous learning

**Benefits**
**What We Offer**
Softheon offers every full-time employee a comprehensive compensation and benefits package including:
  
  

* For this position we offer a base pay of $122,000- $140,000 plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation, and benefits. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as candidate location, qualifications, skill level, and competencies
* Work from your home company with a one-time home office stipend
* Comprehensive benefits package that includes health, vision and dental coverage for you, your spouse and dependents
* Additional benefits, including a monthly wellness stipend and internet stipend, 401K w/ a match; immediately vested, employee assistance program, disability/life insurance, and parental leave
* 15 days to discretionary PTO based on YOS
* 9 additional paid holidays
* Referral bonuses, discretionary bonus program, spot bonuses and professional development opportunities
* Please note that candidates applying for this position must reside within the United States

Eligibility to Work in the U.S.: We are unable to sponsor or assist with visa-related processes. Candidates must have valid work authorization to work in the U.S. without any current or future need for employer sponsorship.
  
  
Join Softheon, and together, we'll shape the future of healthcare in America.
  
  
Are you ready to make a difference? Join us at Softheon and help revolutionize healthcare for all.
  
  
At Softheon, we embrace and celebrate diversity in all its forms as an equal opportunity employer. We strongly believe that employing a diverse workforce is key to our success. Our recruitment and hiring decisions are made solely on the basis of each candidate's qualifications, experience, and skills. Title: Major Incident IT Manager, Temporary
Description:
**WHY UT SOUTHWESTERN?**
  
With over 75 years of excellence in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, UT Southwestern is committed to excellence, innovation, teamwork, and compassion. As a world-renowned medical and research center, we strive to provide the best possible care, resources, and benefits for our valued employees. Ranked as the No. 1 hospital in Dallas-Fort Worth according to *U.S. News & World Report*, we invest in you with opportunities for career growth and development to align with your future goals. Our highly competitive benefits package offers healthcare, PTO and paid holidays, on-site childcare, wage, merit increases and so much more. We invite you to be a part of the UT Southwestern team where you’ll discover a culture of teamwork, professionalism, and a rewarding career!

**JOB SUMMARY**
  
**This is a 6-month to 1-year temporary position with an opportunity to move to a permanent role depending on performance.**
  
The Major Incident Manager coordinates and manages responses to major IT incidents to minimize business disruption and restore services as quickly as possible. This role serves as the central coordination point throughout the major incident lifecycle, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, managing escalations, coordinating technical teams, and ensuring timely stakeholder communications. Working within established ITIL practices, the position partners with the Incident Management Process Owner, ITSM team, technical resolver groups, Service Desk, Communications Managers, Problem Management, and IT and Hospital leadership. Responsibilities also include supporting Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs), collaborating on Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and tracking follow-up actions. This is a hands-on operational role requiring occasional overnight, weekend, and holiday availability to support major incident response.

**BENEFITS**
  
UT Southwestern is proud to offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees. Our benefits are designed to support your overall wellbeing, and include:

* PPO medical plan, available day one at no cost for full-time employee-only coverage
* 100% coverage for preventive healthcare-no copay
* Paid Time Off, available day one
* Retirement Programs through the Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS)
* Paid Parental Leave Benefit
* Wellness programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) Qualified Employer
  

**Required Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Required Experience**

* **Five or more years of experience in IT Service Management, Incident Management, IT Operations, or a related IT service delivery function.**
* **A minimum of 5 year’s experience as a Major Incident Manager with experience coordinating and leading high-impact incidents, escalations, or cross-functional IT operational activities.**
* Working knowledge of Incident Management and Major Incident Management practices.
* Experience using ServiceNow ITSM, including Incident Management and related workflows.
* Strong understanding of incident prioritization, impact assessment, escalation procedures, and service restoration activities.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple technical teams and stakeholders during time-sensitive situations.
Experience with Post-Incident Reviews, Problem Management, and Root Cause Analysis is preferred.  

**Preffered Experience**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences and leadership.
* Strong facilitation, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to remain composed, exercise sound judgment, and manage competing priorities in high-pressure situations.
* Demonstrated accountability, attention to detail, and ability to maintain accurate incident documentation and timelines.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across organizational boundaries.
ITIL 4 Foundation certification preferred; ITIL v5 certification or relevant ITSM training is a plus.  

**Work Schedule & Availability**
  
This is a temporary to permanent, full-time position. While the position will generally operate during standard business hours, overnight, weekend, and holiday work will be required periodically to support major incident response, service restoration, and operational coverage. Flexibility and availability outside of normal business hours are essential requirements of this position.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
  
**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the end-to-end lifecycle of major incidents, from identification and declaration through service restoration and closure.
* Assess incident impact and urgency, validate escalation criteria, and facilitate appropriate major incident designation.
* Serve as the central coordination point for major incident response activities across technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Initiate, facilitate, and manage major incident bridges, ensuring appropriate participation, structure, and progress.
* Coordinate technical resolver groups, monitor investigation activities, track action items, and identify barriers to resolution.
* Facilitate prioritization, escalation, and resource coordination to support timely service restoration.
* Ensure incident records, timelines, decisions, actions, and status updates are accurately maintained in ServiceNow.
* Coordinate timely and consistent communications with IT leadership, business stakeholders, affected departments, and other impacted audiences.
* Partner with Major Incident Process Owner and Communications Managers to ensure communications are accurate, appropriate, and delivered according to established standards.
* Monitor incident progress and provide status updates, escalation notifications, and executive summaries as appropriate.
* Ensure appropriate handoffs between Major Incident Management, Incident Management, and Problem Management.
* Participate in and facilitate post-incident reviews (PIRs), documenting lessons learned, response effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with the Problem Manager on root cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
* Ensure outstanding action items and follow-up activities are documented, assigned, and tracked through completion.
* Maintain adherence to established ITIL practices, operational procedures, escalation guidelines, and communication standards.
* Support continual improvement by identifying recurring challenges, process gaps, and opportunities to improve major incident response.
* Provide operational support outside of standard business hours, including overnight, weekends, and holidays as required.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Work requires ability to monitor and maintain budget.
* Work requires ability to ensure adherence to all policies and procedures of university.
* Work requires ability to work with confidential information on a daily basis.
* Work requires ability to effectively interpret and apply organizational policies, procedures, and systems.
* Work requires good interpersonal, organizational, supervisory, and analytical skills.
* Work requires demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and exercise decision-making and problem-solving skills.
* Work requires ability to read, write, develop plans, procedures, and coordinate persons and other resources to accomplish goals.
* Work requires ability to communicate clearly.
* Work requires knowledge of personal computers.
* Work may require ability to lead committees as appropriate.

Title: Lead Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Business Introduction**
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Digital & Tech Command Centre operates 24x7x365 to protect GSK’s critical sites, applications and services. Disruption or degradation to these directly impacts patient supply, research and colleague productivity.
  
  
This role owns and leads the end-to-end response to Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents. In collaboration with AI-enabled monitoring, detection and triage capabilities, the role directs resolver
  
  
teams and subject matter experts from across Tech towards the fastest possible restoration of service, while providing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate communication to end users, senior stakeholders and
  
  
executive leadership. The role also assesses incidents for crisis potential, secures the quality of the incident record for downstream Problem Management, and drives continuous improvement in prevention, detection and response - including the adoption of AI and automation to shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore. As a more experienced member of the Major Incident Manager team, the role additionally acts as an escalation point within the team, to support less experienced colleagues, as well as to field senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information. Additionally, the role supports management of the shift rota, supports the personal
  
  
development of Major Incident Managers through structured feedback and mentoring and leads service-related objectives such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
**Major Incident Response & Command**

* Own the end-to-end management of Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents, from detection through to confirmed service restoration, acting as the single point of control for the duration of the incident.
* Rapidly establish impact, urgency and scope, confirm correct prioritisation, and drive immediate engagement of the right resolver teams, subject matter experts and vendors.
* Lead technical bridges with authority, keeping activity focused on restoration, controlling scope, and ensuring hypotheses are tested and eliminated systematically.
* Drive and record decisions under pressure – balancing speed of restoration against risk.
* Drive resolution against agreed major incident targets, escalating promptly where progress stalls or
* additional authority, resource or vendor commitment is required.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Own incident communications, producing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate updates, including for senior leaders, at agreed intervals.
* Translate complex technical detail into clear business impact language, setting realistic expectations on restoration.
* Act as an escalation point for senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information, coordinating accurate, consistent responses across resolver teams and owning follow-up through to closure.

**Incident Assessment, Categorisation & Escalation**

* Continuously assess live incidents for impact, applying criteria to determine appropriate handling.
* Trigger escalation routes without delay, providing the initial situational assessment.
* Maintain awareness of site criticality, business-critical periods and service dependencies so that escalation decisions reflect true business risk.

**Service Quality, Data & Continuous Improvement**

* Secure the quality, completeness and accuracy of the incident record – timeline, impact, actions taken and causal indicators – so that Problem Management can be effective.
* Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews, ensuring findings, follow-up actions and preventative measures are captured, owned and tracked to closure.
* Identify recurring themes, fragile services and gaps in monitoring, alerting, knowledge or runbooks, and feed these into improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to the development and adoption of AI, automation and data-driven tooling that shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore.
* Drive continual improvements into process and playbooks.
* Lead defined service-related objectives, such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives, owning them end to end and tracking measurable improvement.

**Shift Operations & Readiness**

* Operate as part of a 24x7x365 shift pattern, including public holiday and on-call working as required.
* Support management of the shift rota, helping to ensure balanced, compliant 24x7x365 cover across regions, and flagging gaps, fatigue and coverage risks to the Senior Major Incident Manager.
* Deliver rigorous shift handovers so that live incidents, risks and pending actions transfer seamlessly with no loss of context or momentum.
* Maintain personal and team readiness through participation in recovery tests, crisis simulations and major incident rehearsals.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Acts as an escalation point within the team, providing support to less experienced colleagues.
* Support the personal development of Major Incident Managers, including through structured feedback sessions and mentoring, helping to raise the capability, consistency and resilience of the MIM
* community.
* Approach and Collaboration
* Bring a team-first collaborative mindset and approach, to ensure effective cross-functional working.

Why You?
  
  
**Basic Qualification**
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, IT or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years in IT service operations within a large, complex, global organisation, including time in a Major Incident Management role.
* ITIL v4 certification is required.
* Experience with leading P1 incidents end to end, directing multiple technical teams and third parties concurrently.
* Experience communicating during live incidents to a range of audiences, including senior leaders, under time pressure.
* Experience working to defined service levels and KPIs, with evidence of improving incident response performance.
* Experience of 24x7 shift-based and on-call working, including structured handover.
* Experience of enterprise ITSM tooling (ServiceNow preferred) and
* monitoring/alerting platforms.
* Experience in a regulated industry (pharmaceutical, life sciences, financial services or similar) desirable

**Preferred Qualification**

Title: Engineering Manager, Head of Data & Info Delivery Platform, MD
Description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
--------------------------

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager, Head of Data & Info Delivery Platform, MD to provide end-to-end technology leadership for a strategic business platform focused on digital integration, collaboration, data and report delivery.

This leader will be accountable for the platform’s **technology strategy, architecture, engineering, delivery, operational resilience, risk posture, modernization, financial performance, and talent** . The successful candidate will combine strong technology depth with business and client orientation, translating strategic priorities into a multi-year platform roadmap while ensuring the platform remains secure, resilient, scalable, and cost effective.

The role requires a senior leader who can operate across Product, Operations, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Risk, and other technology organizations while leading a globally distributed engineering organization.

**Why This Role Is Important to Us**
------------------------------------

Our technology platforms are fundamental to how we deliver services to our clients and operate the business. The Technology Platform Leader provides clear, end-to-end accountability for the health, evolution, and business value of the platform.

The role is responsible for balancing three objectives:

* **Run the platform exceptionally well** with high availability, resilience, security, and effective risk management.
* **Modernize and simplify the platform** to reduce complexity, technical debt, and total cost of ownership.
* **Advance the platform strategically** by applying modern engineering, cloud, data, automation, and AI capabilities to improve client and operational outcomes.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
------------------------------------

### **Platform Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the overall technology strategy, architecture, roadmap, and lifecycle of the platform.
* Establish a clear multi-year technology roadmap aligned with business, product, operations, client, and enterprise technology priorities.
* Act as the senior technology point of accountability for platform health, delivery, investment, risk, modernization, and business outcomes.
* Define measurable technology outcomes and ensure investments deliver appropriate business value and return on investment.

### **Architecture, Engineering & Modernization**

* Provide technology and architecture leadership across applications, services, data, integration, infrastructure, and cloud components supporting the platform.
* Drive simplification and modernization of legacy technology, reducing fragmentation, manual processes, technical debt, and unnecessary technology complexity.
* Advance modern engineering practices including APIs, cloud-native architectures, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, data-driven operations, and responsible adoption of AI.
* Ensure solutions conform to enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data, engineering, and technology standards.
* Create reusable platform capabilities instead of point solutions wherever doing so improves scale, speed, and economics.

### **Delivery & Execution**

* Lead execution of major platform programs, regulatory commitments, client initiatives, technology upgrades, and releases.
* Establish strong engineering and SDLC disciplines with clear accountability for quality, schedule, scope, and financial outcomes.
* Partner closely with Product and Operations to translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps.
* Identify execution challenges early and drive decisions, issue resolution, and remediation across organizational boundaries.

### **Resilience, Risk & Operational Excellence**

* Maintain strong platform availability, resilience, performance, capacity, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Own the platform technology risk posture and drive timely remediation of vulnerabilities, audit findings, control gaps, end-of-life technology, and technical debt.
* Establish meaningful metrics and SLAs for platform health and use them to continuously improve operational performance.
* Lead major incident management, root-cause analysis, and sustainable remediation when significant technology issues occur.
* Embed cybersecurity, control, compliance, and resilience requirements directly into platform engineering.

### **Financial & Vendor Management**

* Own technology execution within the platform budget and contribute to investment prioritization and multi-year financial planning.
* Continuously improve platform economics by simplifying architecture, reducing technical debt, eliminating unnecessary duplication, and improving engineering productivity.
* Manage strategic technology vendors and delivery partners, establishing clear accountability for cost, risk, quality, and outcomes.
* Make transparent investment trade-offs across growth, modernization, mandatory change, risk reduction, and platform maintenance.

### **Stakeholder & Client Leadership**

* Build strong partnerships across Product, Operations, Client Services, Risk, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, and other technology organizations.
* Communicate platform strategy, investment priorities, delivery progress, operational health, and technology risks clearly to senior leadership.
* Represent Technology in senior business, client, governance, and regulatory discussions where appropriate.
* Influence across organizational boundaries and drive alignment where priorities or objectives compete.

### **Organization & Talent Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global engineering organization.
* Develop strong senior technology leaders and establish succession plans for critical leadership and technical roles.
* Create a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, transparency, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop critical technical capabilities internally while using strategic partners appropriately to provide capacity or specialized expertise.

**What We Value**
-----------------

The following capabilities will help you succeed in this role:

* **Technology Platform Ownership & Strategic Leadership** : demonstrated accountability for large-scale, business-critical technology platforms.
* **Architecture & Modernization Expertise** : deep understanding of enterprise application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, cloud, integration, and modern engineering practices.
* **Risk, Resilience & Operational Excellence** : experience operating highly available technology in a regulated environment with strong cybersecurity, controls, resilience, and production-management disciplines.
* **Large-Scale Program & Financial Management** : demonstrated ability to manage complex transformation portfolios, technology budgets, vendors, delivery commitments, and competing investment priorities.
* **Executive & Business Leadership** : ability to translate technology into business outcomes and influence senior stakeholders across Technology, Product, Operations, Risk, and Client organizations.
* **Talent Leadership** : proven ability to build global engineering organizations, develop senior leaders, attract strong technical talent, and create succession depth.

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* **15+ years of technology experience** , including significant leadership responsibility for complex enterprise platforms and engineering organizations.
* Demonstrated experience leading technology in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Strong experience across application development, architecture, production management, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud and modern cloud-native engineering practices.
* Experience delivering major application modernization and technology transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of technology risk, cybersecurity, resiliency, regulatory controls, and operational risk.
* Experience managing significant technology budgets, strategic vendors, and globally distributed teams.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with executive management, clients, regulators, business leaders, and deeply technical teams.

**Leadership Success Measures**
-------------------------------

Success in this role will ultimately be demonstrated through:

* **Platform stability:** resilient, secure, highly available services.
* **Predictable execution:** strategic and client commitments delivered with quality.
* **Reduced risk:** measurable improvement in vulnerabilities, technology debt, control gaps, and end-of-life technology.
* **Modernization:** simpler architecture, increased automation, and adoption of strategic engineering patterns.
* **Improved economics:** lower platform complexity and total cost of ownership with stronger return on technology investment.
* **Business impact:** faster delivery of capabilities that improve client experience and operational outcomes.
* **Organizational strength:** a high-performing engineering organization with strong leadership depth and succession.

**Work Requirement**

* Onsite 4 days a week in office and one day remote
* Standard business hours aligned to project and stakeholder needs(8am to 5pm)

$170,000 - $267,500 Annual
